Title: Evaluation Chickpea Bowl app-01 1ed4b9cc-7b9f-44f9-aecd-fce8b1d7633c
Section: ingredients

* 250 g drained canned chickpeas
* 200 g cooked rice
* 1 tbsp olive oil
* 1 tsp ground cumin

Document: evaluation-app-01-1ed4b9cc-7b9f-44f9-aecd-fce8b1d7633c.md
Title: Evaluation Chickpea Bowl app-01 1ed4b9cc-7b9f-44f9-aecd-fce8b1d7633c
Section: steps

1. Heat the olive oil in a pan.
2. Add the drained chickpeas and ground cumin. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
3. Add the already cooked rice and stir for 2 minutes.
4. Divide into 2 servings.
